summary: Bright Minds Biosciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 2, 2026 news release disclosing that the FDA placed its IND and Protocol BMB-101-105 for developmental and epileptic encephalopathies on partial clinical hold. The hold covers only the planned U.S. Phase 2 randomized, placebo-controlled dose-escalation trial; other ongoing trials are unaffected. FDA cited mouse toxicity and inadequate pharmacokinetic and juvenile toxicity data supporting pediatric enrollment. The full hold letter is expected within 30 days. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are present; watch regulatory timelines and any capital-raising or partnership implications.
